options.name: Fatecaster Greatbows and Close Combat Weapons

master-psyker.name: Master Psyker
master-psyker.text: Once per battle, at the end of the Orders phase, you can look through your Command Asset deck and draw either one Thousand Sons Command Asset of your choice that is a psychic power, or the Deny the Witch or Adamantium Will card. Add the drawn card to your hand, then shuffle the Command Asset deck and place it face down.

daemon-prince-of-tzeentch.name: Daemon Prince of Tzeentch
daemon-prince-of-tzeentch.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly THOUSAND SONS and TZEENTCH DAEMON units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

relic-hunters.name: Relic Hunters
relic-hunters.text: You can re-roll hit rolls for attacks made with melee weapons by this unit that target CHARACTER units.

bestial-prophet.name: Bestial Prophet
bestial-prophet.text: Add 1 to hit rolls for attacks made by friendly TZAANGOR units whilst they are within 6" of any friendly units with this ability.

slashing-attack.name: Slashing Attack
slashing-attack.text: When this unit finishes making a Move action, select one enemy unit it moved over whilst making that Move action. Roll a number of D6 equal to this unit’s Attacks characteristic, subtracting 1 from each result if that unit is a Character; for each result of 5+ place one blast marker next to that unit.

warp-vortex.name: Warp Vortex
warp-vortex.text: When you select this unit’s Detachment to carry out its order, but before any units in that Detachment make an action (excluding free actions) that phase, roll one D3, and apply the result from the table below.

1-warp-flare.name: 1 - Warp Flare
1-warp-flare.text: Place one blast marker next to each enemy unit within 9" of this unit.

2-temporal-flux.name: 2 - Temporal Flux
2-temporal-flux.text: Select one friendly TZEENTCH unit within 9" of this unit. Until the end of the turn, add 1 to that unit’s Attacks characteristic.

3-beam-of-unreality.name: 3 - Beam of Unreality
3-beam-of-unreality.text: Place four blast markers next to the closest enemy unit within 18" of this unit and visible to it. If multiple enemy units are equally close, select one and place four blast markers next to it instead.

primarch-of-the-thousand-sons.name: Primarch of the Thousand Sons
primarch-of-the-thousand-sons.text: You can re-roll hit rolls and wound rolls for attacks made by friendly THOUSAND SONS units whilst they are within 9" of this unit.

magnus-the-red.name: Magnus the Red
magnus-the-red.text: Once per battle, at the end of the Orders phase, you can look through your Command Asset deck and draw either one Thousand Sons Command Asset of your choice that is a psychic power, or the Deny the Witch or Adamantium Will card. Add the drawn card to your hand, then shuffle the Command Asset deck and place it face down.

lord-of-the-thousand-sons.name: Lord of the Thousand Sons
lord-of-the-thousand-sons.text: Re-roll hit rolls of 1 for attacks made by friendly THOUSAND SONS units whilst they are within 6" of this unit.

legacy-of-the-rubricae.name: Legacy of the Rubricae
legacy-of-the-rubricae.text: If this unit is in a Detachment that contains only THOUSAND SONS units, its Battlefield Role is Troops instead of Elites.
